elements_not_encoded.text: Treat the HIV positive patient in labour
elements_not_encoded.reason: Header of a treatment box (ART in labour), not an urgent-attention box; no triage or diagnostic criteria to encode. Brief scope excludes manage tasks.

elements_not_encoded.text: Note: fill 'C#DELIVERY' on blood request form code field so that VL not rejected.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Administrative note about the lab request form code; no clinical logic.

elements_not_encoded.text: If on ART, continue ART throughout delivery. Check viral load, regardless of when last done, and review results at 3-6 day postnatal visit.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Continue ART and send viral load: treatment and lab-ordering steps. A viral load result also has no unit/observable in the language.

elements_not_encoded.text: If not on ART, give together single dose NVP 200mg as early as possible in labour and single dose TLD: TDF/3TC/DTG 300/300/50mg.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Medicines and doses (NVP, TLD) for the patient not on ART; out of scope (no manage tasks, no medicines).

elements_not_encoded.text: Give ideally during early labour, and urgently if delivery is imminent.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Timing of the intrapartum medicine doses; management detail.

elements_not_encoded.text: Start patient on ART next day 126. Give 2 months ART supply.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Start ART next day (pointer to 126) and 2-month supply; management.

elements_not_encoded.text: Decide HIV transmission risk of HIV-exposed baby and give infant prophylaxis according to risk 186.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Infant risk assessment and prophylaxis (pointer to 186) concern the baby and are management; not adult triage logic.

elements_not_encoded.text: DTG - dolutegravir; FTC – emtricitabine; NVP - nevirapine; TDF – tenofovir; 3TC – lamivudine, TLD - TDF/3TC/DTG or tenofovir/lamivudine/dolutegravir

judgment_calls.decision: Comment-only .lisp file. The only red box is a treatment box (HIV positive patient in labour), not a 'give urgent attention' box, and the page has no 'X likely' / 'consider X' statements; everything is advice, treatment or scheduling.
judgment_calls.alternatives: A check_for task for 'on ART' triggered by HIV in labour, or a measure task for viral load; rejected because the page uses these only to choose medicines (management), and viral load has no unit in the language.

judgment_calls.topic: Outside sections (advise/treat the pregnant patient, review schedule)
judgment_calls.decision: Not encoded: all management, education, medicines or visit scheduling. 'If gestational hypertension... If proteinuria/new symptoms, refer urgently' is a referral step defined on page 179, not a triage criterion of this page.
judgment_calls.alternatives: A priority rule for gestational hypertension with proteinuria; rejected as a referral/management step and as belonging to page 179.
